area.title: Blitzer.de Setup
area.description: Select the section from which the data should be displayed

tracker.title: Blitzer.de Setup
tracker.description: Pick the device tracker to follow and how wide a circle to search around it. Only trackers currently reporting coordinates are listed - one that knows nothing but home and away has no position to put a circle around.

waypoint.title: Add waypoint {count}
waypoint.description: Move the map to place waypoint {count} of the route. Add at least two waypoints; a corridor is searched along the straight lines between them, so place a waypoint on every sharp bend of the actual route.

route_options.title: Route search options
route_options.description: Choose how wide a corridor around the route to search, and which reports to include.

ors_key.title: openrouteservice
ors_key.description:
The route is worked out by openrouteservice. It needs an API key, which is free:

1. Sign up at [openrouteservice.org]({url}) and confirm the e-mail you receive.
2. Log in. Your profile page shows the key at the top, **Basic Key**, with a copy button next to it.
3. Paste it here.

The key is only used while a route is set up or changed. If a key is already saved, leave the field empty to keep it. A saved key is used for every further route without being asked for again.

data_description.ors_return_route: A second entry, destination to start, worked out by openrouteservice as well - on a motorway the way back is the other carriageway, and a tailback on one is not one on the other. Named after this entry, with "return" added.

entry_failing.title: {name} is not delivering
entry_failing.description:
The Blitzer.de entry **{name}** has failed {count} polls in a row, so its entities are unavailable. The last reason:

`{reason}`

A tracker without a position, or a tracker entity that no longer exists, is fixed under the entry's **Configure**; if Blitzer.de itself cannot be reached, this clears on its own once it can. This repair goes away with the next poll that succeeds.
